title: I Built an AI That Turns Business Central Telemetry Into GitHub Issues (Automatically)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of telemetry triage tool
Solution architecture and GitHub issue generation
Visual Studio Code demo - table, codeunit, and page
AI analysis and GitHub issue resolution
Infrastructure as code and expanding the solution

features.name: Automated BC telemetry triage with Azure Logic App and AI
features.description: A tool that runs daily to capture Business Central telemetry events from Application Insights, analyzes them using AI, and automatically generates GitHub issues with root cause analysis and resolutions.
caveats: Demo focuses on RT00002 event type but can be expanded to other events
Requires setup of Azure services and GitHub repository access

features.name: KQL query for database lock timeouts
features.description: A Kusto Query Language query that retrieves traces from Application Insights where the event ID is RT00002 to identify database locking timeout events.
caveats: Can be extended to multiple event types

features.name: GitHub issue generation from telemetry
features.description: The logic app generates GitHub issues containing the event details, AI-determined root cause analysis, and actionable resolutions based on telemetry data.

features.name: AI-powered root cause analysis
features.description: An AI tool that analyzes telemetry events and GitHub repository content to determine root causes and provide actionable fixes for database performance issues.
caveats: Prompt engineering required for optimal results
Focuses on database performance and locking issues

features.name: Blob storage watermark for incremental runs
features.description: A text file stored in Azure Blob Storage that tracks the last successful run time of the logic app, enabling incremental KQL queries to avoid re-processing historical data.
caveats: Manual initialization needed if file does not exist

features.name: GitHub REST API for issue and label creation
features.description: Uses GitHub REST API endpoints to programmatically create issues and labels in a repository, including setting custom colors and names for telemetry-related labels.
caveats: Requires GitHub authentication and API access
Labels must be pre-configured or created via API

features.name: Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and YAML
features.description: Azure services like Logic App, Application Insights, and Blob Storage can be exported and deployed using Bicep or YAML templates for infrastructure automation.
caveats: Requires knowledge of Bicep or YAML syntax
